root_cause_candidates.reason: A bare ADD cue was emitted as a semantic mention with candidate_roles=[], violating the strict schema.
negations contained literal cue text outside the affected semantic mention instead of its existing mention ID.
A model selected an offered active-task handle as historical despite no HISTORICAL signal. The runtime guard rejects it even with a null-only generation schema.
The explicit catalog metric order-count surface was split into an order entity and a count fragment. Later temporal-base rejection is not evidence that the first error was temporal.
The parse and draft choose GROUPED_AGGREGATE without requested grouping; contract rejection still needs exact replay, and task-operation correctness is separately unproven.

proven_root_cause.before: A lone REMOVE act and agreeing current REMOVE markers were ignored when duplicate followup/reference signals were empty. The task was treated as NEW_TASK.
proven_root_cause.after: REMOVE/CLEAR dependency uses agreement of one destructive act with all current operation markers. Topic shift wins; mixed/conflicting/absent evidence does not create inheritance.

context_gap.before: All restored tasks and historical handles were exposed on ordinary continuation and complete new tasks; actual prior payload type was omitted.
context_gap.after: Current-task labels only on deterministic continuation, no old tasks for NEW_TASK, historical handles only on explicit historical return. Include restored payload type and clear barriers.
context_gap.runtime_guard: Retained; strengthened for explicit topic shift.

latest_task_context_stage.parser_role_caveat: The retained 100-case role-purity diagnostic scores role hypotheses, not final canonical choices; additional hypotheses alone do not prove a final role or binding production defect.
